_note: Brand-specific steps so alarms ring on time (docs/ALARM.md section 7). Data, not code: update without an app release.

default.title: Let Saff run in the background
steps: Open Settings, then Apps, then Saff.
Set Battery to Unrestricted (or Don't optimise).

xiaomi.title: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO
steps: Settings, Apps, Manage apps, Saff, Autostart: turn on.
Battery saver for Saff: choose No restrictions.
Recent apps: long-press Saff and tap the lock icon.

samsung.title: Samsung
steps: Settings, Battery, Background usage limits: remove Saff from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
Settings, Apps, Saff, Battery: choose Unrestricted.

oppo.title: Oppo / Realme / OnePlus
steps: Settings, Apps, App management, Saff, Battery usage: Allow background activity.
Recent apps: pull Saff down to lock it.

vivo.title: Vivo / iQOO
steps: Settings, Battery, Background power consumption: allow Saff.
Settings, Apps, Autostart: turn on Saff.

huawei.title: Huawei / Honor
steps: Settings, Battery, App launch: set Saff to Manage manually and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
